viewing_check: Photograph and clean-brush the raised lettering on the bar (maker name or registration diamond, e.g. Kenrick, Briscone, Carron); check for cracks, repairs and that both finials and the tray are intact; confirm it is old casting not a modern reproduction (sand-cast texture, weight).
